_comment: Every ward of Adur, Worthing and Brighton & Hove with its scheduled bus service, for Route view's Areas layer. Built weekly by scripts/build_localities.py.

source.name: ONS Open Geography Portal
source.attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025. Contains National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right 2025.

caveats: Scheduled departures from the published timetable for one dated week, not buses that ran.
A ward's stops are those inside it with at least one departure that week; a stop on the line between two wards counts in the one its point falls in.
Only wards centred in the area this site covers are shown. Its timetable holds the stops in that area, so a ward reaching beyond it can be under-counted; such a ward is marked.
A day runs from 04:00 to 04:00: the first bus is the first from 04:00, the last the last before 04:00 the next morning.
Shelter and step-free access are as recorded in OpenStreetMap, which does not yet describe every stop: a low share can mean unrecorded, not missing.
